The test image shows a soybean leaf with small, scattered yellowish-green spots and tiny tan/brown raised spots. The leaf is pubescent (hairy). This is a **leaf** disease, narrowing to 16 candidates.

Top candidates based on symptoms: Bacterial_Pustule, Soybean_rust, Downy_mildew, Frogeye_leaf_spot. Let me check references one at a time.
Bacterial_Pustule reference shows a heavily magnified, advanced lesion. Not very comparable. Let me check Soybean_rust.

Soybean rust shows small, scattered brown spots on green leaves. Similar pattern but the test image spots appear more yellowish-green with smaller, less distinct brown spots. Let me check Downy_mildew.
Downy mildew shows yellow-green spots on upper leaf surface, very similar to the test image pattern. Strong match. Let me check Frogeye_leaf_spot.
Frogeye leaf spot shows distinct circular lesions with gray centers and dark borders, plus holes. Very different from the test image. Let me check Septoria_brown_spot.
Septoria brown spot shows dark brown spots on yellowing lower canopy leaves. Different pattern. Let me check Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.
SVN virus shows fewer, larger yellow/brown irregular spots along veins. Different from the many small scattered spots in the test image. Let me check Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus.

BPMV shows mottling and leaf puckering, very different pattern. I've used 7 views across 7 classes. My strongest match is Downy_mildew. Let me use my last view to confirm with another Downy_mildew reference.

This second Downy_mildew reference shows early-stage small yellow-green spots on the upper leaf surface, which matches the test image pattern well.

**Analysis summary:**
- The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, scattered yellowish-green spots and some small tan/brown spots on the upper surface
- Downy mildew reference (Dise_137) shows nearly identical scattered yellow-green spots across the leaf surface
- Downy mildew reference (Dise_75) shows the early stage with similar small yellow spots
- The symptom description matches: "Small light green spots on upper leaf surfaces that enlarge and turn pale to bright yellow"
- Soybean rust was the next closest but its spots are more distinctly brown/tan rather than the yellow-green seen here
- Other candidates (Frogeye, Septoria, SVN virus, BPMV, Bacterial Pustule) showed clearly different patterns
